import os
import re
import subprocess
from langchain_core.tools import tool
_PAT = re.compile('^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*(\\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)?$')


def _log_run(dsn, table, full):
    sql = (
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vacuum_log "
        "(table_name text, full_vacuum boolean, ran_at timestamptz DEFAULT now());"
        "INSERT INTO vacuum_log (table_name, full_vacuum) VALUES (:'t', :'f');"
    )
    subprocess.run(['psql', dsn, '-v', f't={table}', '-v', f'f={str(full).lower()}'],
                   input=sql, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)


@tool
def run_vacuum_analyze_job(table: str, full: bool=False) -> str:
    if not _PAT.match(table):
        return 'error: invalid table name'
    dsn = os.environ.get('DATABASE_URL', 'postgresql://localhost/postgres')
    opt = 'FULL, ANALYZE' if full else 'ANALYZE'
    q = f'VACUUM ({opt}) {table};'
    p = subprocess.run(['psql', dsn, '-v', 'ON_ERROR_STOP=1', '-c', q], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3600)
    o = p.stdout.strip()
    e = p.stderr.strip()
    if p.returncode != 0:
        return f'failed ({p.returncode}): {e}'
    _log_run(dsn, table, full)
    return o or 'vacuum complete'
